name: 10JNHF600
variant: JFE Super Core JNHF (graded Si), 0.1 mm, as sheared

provenance.source: JFE catalogue f2e-001 'Magnetic Property Curves', docs/sources/materials/jfe_f2e-001_magnetic_property_curves.pdf, p. 19 'Magnetization Curve' (50 Hz, 25 cm Epstein, rolling direction, as sheared), traced with tools/digitise_bh.py; 32 points log-spaced 15 A/m to 20 kA/m (the traced curve end above it flattens below mu0 and is left to the saturation tail). B8 of the trace 1.140 T against 1.15 T in the JFE Super Core brochure table (f1e-002 p. 6). JYStator laminations are JFE Super Core (JYStator pointed to the German brochure f1g-001).

stacking_factor_source: JFE Super Core brochure f1e-002 product table: space factor 90 % or more (guaranteed minimum used)
saturation_polarisation_source: JFE Super Core brochure f1e-002 p. 6 table: saturation magnetization 1.88 T
density_source: JFE catalogue f2e-001: assumed density 7.53 g/cm3
